Holding down the trigger for 0.45 seconds creates a focused 'Solar Field' that continuously expands. The radius grows up to 4? meters wide over the course of ? seconds, dealing <pve 13.47 /> <pvp [6] /> damage every 0.1 seconds to all enemies within it.

Scoring 20 hits within 1.5 seconds of each with this weapon's beam or Solar Field applies 10 <solar/>Scorch stacks (20 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).
